content:
samir: Quick check  noon express today? 20 min rooftop mobility + light KB work. low intensity, do-able in work clothes.
ellie: yes please. sounds ideal between meetings. :relieved:
dan: count me in. can we do partner rotations? short intervals.
samir: thinking partner swaps so KB doesn't have to be shared for too long. we have one 10kg and one 6kg in supplies.
kia: I can bring my 8kg if needed, will label it. also bringing two extra mats.
courtney: adding a brief ab series so we don't all collapse back at our desks. :grin:
ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop booking is provisional. If facilities declines, fallback is Conference Room C (please bring quiet shoes).
ellie: tiny poll: do we want music? React with :headphones: for yes, :mute: for no.
dan: :headphones:
kia: :mute: (i have sensitive ears)
courtney: :headphones: for me
samir: we'll keep it low. portable speaker at 50% vol.

samir: Plan (20m):
```
12:00-12:04 mobility: banded shoulder pass-throughs, hip CARs, ankle resets
12:04-12:10 kettlebell station (partner 3 min rounds): swings + goblet holds
12:10-12:18 circuit 2 rounds 45s/15s: slow pushups, step-ups, hollow rocks
12:18-12:20 group stretch + foam roll (hamstrings/back)
```

ellie: note: bring water and a light jacket. Rooftop wind can surprise.
dAN: (typo) dan: also, closed-toe shoes for KB please. last time someone almost lost a toe :sweat_smile:
kia: will handle KB logistics and wipes for the handles.
courtney: shoutout to @kia for always bringing the extra sanitizer :sparkles:
samir: if facilities allows recurring booking, do we want this weekly Wed lunchtime? say aye.
ellie: aye
dan: aye
kia: aye
courtney: aye
ops-bot: Facilities asked to confirm number of attendees weekly. Please RSVP by 11:30 on Wednesdays.
samir: final note - if rooftop is a no-go, we move to Conf C and keep it quiet. see you at noon!
